description: Defines a set of React components for a command palette UI, including components for dialog, input, list, group, item, separator, and shortcut. It leverages primitive command components from 'cmdk' and constructs a styled and accessible command interface.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: A wrapper around 'cmdk' Command component with pre-defined styling.

methods.name: CommandDialog
methods.description: A component encapsulating a dialog with a command palette, providing default titles and descriptions, and rendering children within a styled command component.

methods.name: CommandInput
methods.description: A styled input wrapper for the command palette input, including a search icon.

methods.name: CommandList
methods.description: A styled list container for command items.

methods.name: CommandEmpty
methods.description: Component showing a placeholder when no command results are found.

methods.name: CommandGroup
methods.description: Groups related command items together with heading styles.

methods.name: CommandItem
methods.description: A selectable command item with styling for selected or disabled states.

methods.name: CommandShortcut
methods.description: Displays keyboard shortcuts associated with commands.

methods.name: CommandSeparator
methods.description: Visual separator between command groups or items.
